message: The other day, I decided to make a fancy dinner—nothing like a little culinary adventure, right? 🍳 Well, let’s just say my smoke alarm got more action than my stovetop! As I flailed around looking for that pesky fire extinguisher, I realized how unprepared I really was for even the simplest mishap. It was a bit comical, but it reminded me of the importance of having a kitchen safety plan and knowing where my smoke alarms are. Who knew cooking could be such a lesson in readiness? Have you ever had a kitchen adventure go sideways?
